historical_training_source.matched_selection: stable_hash_family_order; one narrative_0 per class; 30 families

strategies.A_historical_matched: 90 historical TRAIN rows; new common validation selects parameters
strategies.C_mixed_matched: 45 historical TRAIN + 45 new TRAIN; keep source identities
strategies.A_historical_full_sensitivity: all 204 historical TRAIN rows; sample-size sensitivity, not matched main comparison

selection: highest new common VALIDATION macro-F1 per estimator; fixed grid-order ties
svm_calibration: 3 group-disjoint TRAIN folds; vectorizers inside folds; existing helper
challenge_policy: freeze catalog/protocol and selection before scoring; no test-derived revisions; later identical CI runs are reproductions, not new optimization trials
historical_test_status: previously inspected and influential on hypotheses; not blind final tests; no scoring them in this experiment
independence_limit: new challenge has disjoint authored semantic family IDs; same assistant authored splits; not an independent human or blind external evaluation

near_duplicate_audit.method: unfitted all-pairs character5 and word3 Jaccard across new roles

unlabeled_cohorts.ambiguity: review-referral rate only; intended_review by author, not human gold
unlabeled_cohorts.illustrative: four user examples; no fitting or sentiment accuracy

bootstrap.pairing: same resampled families for strategy differences
bootstrap.scope: synthetic sensitivity only; not population inference

artifact_policy: new versioned data/processed and artifacts directories only; refuse overwrite
beto_scope: encoder/tokenization smoke only, no sentiment classifier, no fine-tuning, no DEMO integration
